design_fields.q1_rationale: The study used average plausible values, which does not meet the criteria for proper handling of plausible values.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study uses ILSA student-level data but does not mention whether sampling weights were applied.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study analyzed data at the country level and did not use multilevel modeling or account for school clustering in its analysis.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study performed only internal validation without mentioning any external validation strategies.
